description: This is a build order for a 2TC Byzantines build order, inspired by the 2TC OoTD 4:30 of Valdemar. I am a noob so you guys can make this cleaner than I did.
name: Byzantines 2TC 4:30
author: Acanthophis

notes: Once you got the 200 @resource/resource_gold.webp@ move to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ (or @resource/resource_stone.webp@ if it is closer)
2x @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ (in the video I move the vills at 2:15, so you can get your 2TC at 4:20)

get 3 from @resource/resource_food.webp@ to @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ 1 to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ keep @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/resource_stone.webp@ to hit 4 then @resource/rally.webp@ on ::str. If you did @resource/resource_gold.webp@ to @resource/resource_stone.webp@ at 02:00 then @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@. You just need 4 on @resource/resource_stone.webp@. You keep 7 on food after @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ for 1-2 dropoff so that 3 on @resource/resource_food.webp@ can sustain @unit_worker/villager.webp@ production.

you take 1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ to build 1 @building_economy/house.webp@.  Once the house is done, you take him + 1 from @resource/resource_stone.webp@ so you build the @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ with 3 now. You only need 268 @resource/resource_stone.webp@ by the @age/age_2.webp@ because the @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ will give you 32. Keep @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ until @age/age_2.webp@

Congratulations! You reached @age/age_2.webp@ with 400 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and 300 @resource/resource_stone.webp@. Start building your second @building_economy/town-center.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ with the 10x @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from the @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@. I keep my @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @landmark_byzantines/grand-winery-1.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@ and add the 3 from @resource/sheep.webp@ to them. The 3 on stone remain there to complere my @building_byzantines/cistern-1.webp@ Network as fast as possible. @resource/rally.webp@ on @resource/berrybush.webp@ with main @building_economy/town-center.webp@. I like to have about 12-14 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ so I can go to @building_byzantines/mercenary-house-2.webp@ and other militray buildings right away, have wood for @building_byzantines/olive-grove-1.webp@ and @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ in case I want to defend @resource/resource_gold.webp@ / @resource/resource_stone.webp@. You don't even need to go out for another @resource/berrybush.webp@.

(In the video you will see that I misclicked and garrisoned 1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ at the last dropoff before the second @building_economy/town-center.webp@ placement, it is irrelevant to the timing of the @building_economy/town-center.webp@ placement as he was working before that on @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@.)

description: Fast Castle byzantin avec double pack de Keshigs. Pression rapide en âge 3 grâce aux Keshigs (mercenaires) et transition full cavalerie lourde Cataphracte. Excellent en multi (2v2/3v3/4v4) et jouable en 1v1 contre des civilisations lentes ou double TC.
name: Fast Castle Keshig + Cataphracte - Jeando tuto
author: Readix

notes: Envoyer les 6 premiers @unit_worker/villager.webp@ sur les @resource/sheep.webp@ — commencer par les B les plus éloignées du @building_economy/town-center.webp@.
Tip : commencer par les moutons loin du TC protège des rushs — les B proches restent accessibles plus tard.
Les 2 premiers @unit_worker/villager.webp@ sortant du @building_economy/town-center.webp@ vont directement sur @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
Construire le @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ dès que possible sur la @resource/resource_gold.webp@.
Dès que le @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ est terminé, construire immédiatement la @landmark_byzantines/cistern-of-the-first-hill-2.webp@ (citerne).
Placer la citerne pour booster @resource/resource_food.webp@ moutons + @resource/resource_gold.webp@ + @resource/resource_food.webp@ B si possible.
Construire l'@landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@ — le placer dans la zone d'influence (carré) de la citerne pour accélérer la production militaire.
Construire un @building_defensive/outpost.webp@ avancé et une @building_economy/house.webp@ supplémentaire.
⚠️ Ne pas supprimer les arbres autour — vous avez besoin de 3 arbres pour ce build.
Lancer immédiatement le contrat des @unit_byzantines/keshik-2.webp@ Keshigs (coûte 400 huile d'olive — vous en avez 800 : 2 packs possibles).
Lancer le 2ème pack de @unit_byzantines/keshik-2.webp@ Keshigs (2x400 huile d'olive depuis les 6 B = 800 au total).
Placer la citerne d'avance sur un point d'intérêt : B + @resource/resource_gold.webp@ si possible.
Envoyer un @unit_worker/villager.webp@ construire un aqueduc pour relier les deux citernes.
Dès l'âge 3 : lancer le contrat vétéran sur les @unit_byzantines/keshik-2.webp@ Keshigs.
Si le moulin est sous la citerne, activer Dialectique.
Activer le Glops automatique sur la citerne : +25 HP/s pendant 6s sur les unités à faible vie.
Utiliser Triomphe de l'Hippodrome lors des grands combats (+dégâts, +vitesse, régénération).

Rechercher @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@ Résistance aux flèches rang 1 puis @technology_byzantines/teardrop-shields-3.webp@ +1 armure corps à corps ET distance sur @unit_byzantines/cataphract-3.webp@.
Ajouter des @building_military/stable.webp@ écuries pour produire plus de @unit_byzantines/cataphract-3.webp@ Cataphractes.
Combo idéal en multi : @unit_byzantines/cataphract-3.webp@ Cataphractes + @unit_byzantines/keshik-2.webp@ Keshigs (allié archer recommandé).
Réutiliser Triomphe après chaque combat — les points d'approvisionnement (kills) augmentent sa durée.

author: Readix

notes: @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ the back of your base looking for @resource/berrybush.webp@ then the enemy base.
Check if the enemy is rusing you, if so, change to the @landmark_byzantines/imperial-hippodrome-1.webp@ build.
